content: EthTSyn CyclicMsgResumeTime ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00047 : ) represents the timeout value of a cyclicMsgResumeCounter that shall be started when a Sync has been sent immediately , asynchronous to the cyclic transmission . The cyclicMsgResumeCounter shall be decremented on each invocation of EthTSyn _MainFunction() if no Time s ync PDU is transmitted asynchronously.
